summary: CheerPlanner v2.2 testing: Teams-to-Watch imports (CSV/XLSX templates, preview, commit with auto-create placeholder), XLSX templates with Reference sheet (14 categories), and Expenses sort toggle. 16/16 backend tests passed (test_v22_imports_and_sort.py). Frontend verified on mobile viewport (390x844): import hub fmt-csv/fmt-xlsx toggle correctly relabels all 5 cards, teams_to_watch card routes to /import/teams_to_watch and shows pick-file UI, and Expenses sort-toggle switches between 'Recent' and 'Due date' and visibly reorders the list. All flows working as designed. No deprecated Expo packages or red screens detected on the tested screens.
critical_code_review_comments: imports.py teams_to_watch commit auto-creates a placeholder Competition without giving callers any way to opt out (unlike travel's create_missing_competitions flag). If accidental imports happen, users will end up with stray competitions. Consider an opt-in/opt-out toggle in the frontend preview (mirroring travel's createMissingComps), or surface a clearer confirmation.
imports.py /api/import/commit returns 200 even when 0 rows were created and only skipped rows exist; consider returning a softer status or distinguishing complete failure from partial.

Expense sort: when sortMode='recent' the list is shown in whatever order the API returns; there is no explicit sort by incurred_on. Label 'Recent' may be misleading if backend list isn't already sorted DESC by date.
seed_data_creation: Tests create a competition 'TEST_v22 Existing Comp' + a placeholder 'TEST_v22 Placeholder Comp' and append TeamToWatch entries; both competitions are deleted in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend login endpoint returns the JWT under the key 'access_token' (not 'token'); the test fixture handles both. EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is the source-of-truth for the public URL (used by both backend tests and the frontend). All 5 import kinds expose XLSX templates; only expenses/competitions/schedule/travel/teams_to_watch have Reference sheets — Reference sheet only present for kinds in TEMPLATE_NOTES (currently all 5). For teams_to_watch the commit ALWAYS auto-creates placeholder competitions for unmatched names (no opt-out flag), behavior matches the user-choice spec.
